splitButton.$description: A primary button with an attached dropdown-chevron segment — click the main part for the default action, the chevron for a Menu of alternatives. The 'New Message ▾' entry point (New Message / New Group Message) is its driving use case. Shares Button primary's exact fill/size recipe (matched to base) so it reads as one Button that happens to be split; a hairline divider (a darker fill.primaryActive line) separates the two segments, and each segment darkens on hover/press like Button primary. The chevron opens the real Menu component — this owns only the split trigger, not the dropdown contents.

paddingX.$description: Main segment edge padding = Button base.

gap.$description: Icon ↔ label in the main segment.

chevronWidth.$description: 36px — the chevron segment, a touch narrower than a square so the main action stays dominant.

divider.$description: The 1px seam between the two segments — fill.primaryActive (a darker blue), the only place the split shows at rest.
